_readme: Milgard AX650 multi-slide (stacking) and bifold doors from Milgard OneLink quote MQPASG000219-1. Every dollar amount in this file is a FINAL CUSTOMER PRICE. The 45% margin (marginAlreadyIncluded) is already in those amounts. applyMargin is false and pricesAre is customer, so the app must use the numbers as-is. Do not run them through marginFactor(), and do not divide by 0.55. There is no cost column. Height bands are net frame height: band 1 up to 80 inches, band 2 over 80 up to 96, band 3 over 96 up to 119.5. Valid height for every model is 79.5 to 119.5. Pocket is offered on the 4-panel stacking model only, and that adder is also a customer price. There is no 2-panel stacking model and no 5-panel bifold. Glass is fixed Tempered SunCoatMAX. No screens. installLabor is null: there is no AX650 install price yet, so the estimate shows TBD and does not add $0.
